en.warning.pdf_docx_fallback: The built-in PDF engine lost some text, so the file was converted again with the sidecar PDF engine. Tables and page layout may differ from the built-in engine's result.
en.warning.pdf_en_us: Numbers and dates in the PDF use en-US format (3,500,000.50, English month names).
en.warning.pdf_text_missing: Some text of the PDF did not reach the Word file: {missing} of {total} letters are missing (a narrow table column is the usual cause). Check the tables in the result, or use the sidecar PDF engine if it is available.
en.warning.pdf_text_unchecked: The converter could not check whether all of the PDF's text came through. If text is missing from the result, convert the file again or use the separate PDF service.
en.warning.plain_text_layout: Markdown and text do not keep headers, footers, images or page layout.
en.warning.revisions_dropped: Tracked changes are not kept as changes in the result.
en.warning.tables_to_text: A text file has no tables: table rows become lines of text.
en.warning.text_transcoded: The text was in {encoding}. It was converted to UTF-8 before the conversion; if letters look wrong, save the file as UTF-8 and convert it again.
en.warning.translit_formula_text: Text values inside formulas are not transliterated.
en.warning.translit_nothing: Transliteration found no text to convert. Check the direction: the text may already be in the target script.
en.warning.very_hidden_sheet_skipped: The workbook has very hidden sheets (hidden by the author so that a user cannot unhide them). They were not exported.

en.warning.xdfu_copy: This document is marked XDFU (for official use only). Copy {copy} was entered in the audit log, and every output carries a watermark with the copy number, your network address, your user name and the time.
en.warning.xdfu_no_text_layer: XDFU handling is on, and this PDF has no text on its first page (a scan or an image), so it cannot be checked for the XDFU mark and the conversion is refused. Have a person check it, or use a version with a text layer.
en.warning.xdfu_no_watermark: This document is marked XDFU (for official use only), and a {target} result cannot carry the required watermark, so the conversion is refused. Choose docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf, png, txt, md, csv or html as the result.
en.warning.xdfu_refused: This document is marked XDFU (for official use only), and this converter is set to refuse such documents. Nothing was converted.
en.warning.xls_pdf_chart_page: Opening the legacy .xls format drops charts, so the PDF can have fewer pages than the same workbook saved as .xlsx.

ru.warning.xdfu_copy: Документ имеет гриф ДСП («Для служебного пользования»). Экземпляр № {copy} записан в журнал аудита, а на каждый результат нанесён водяной знак с номером экземпляра, вашим сетевым адресом, именем пользователя и временем.
ru.warning.xdfu_no_text_layer: Контроль ДСП включён, но на первой странице этого PDF нет текста (скан или изображение), поэтому проверить его на гриф ДСП нельзя, и конвертация отклонена. Пусть файл проверит сотрудник вручную, или используйте версию с текстовым слоем.
ru.warning.xdfu_no_watermark: Документ имеет гриф ДСП («Для служебного пользования»), а на результат в формате {target} нельзя нанести обязательный водяной знак, поэтому конвертация отклонена. Выберите для результата формат docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf, png, txt, md, csv или html.
ru.warning.xdfu_refused: Документ имеет гриф ДСП («Для служебного пользования»), а этот конвертер настроен отклонять такие документы. Ничего не конвертировано.
